claims: SpaceX successfully launched 25 Starlink satellites aboard a Falcon 9 rocket from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California
SpaceX launched them on Monday, April 6, 2026
SpaceX launched them at 4:03 p.m. PT
The launch followed a Sunday scrub
The mission launched from Space Launch Complex 4E
The booster landed on a drone ship in the Pacific Ocean
Starlink 17-35 launched from Vandenberg on April 6, 2026
Starlink 17-35 carried 25 satellites to low-Earth orbit
SpaceX has additional Starlink missions scheduled for April 8, 9, and 11, 2026, according to the official SpaceX launch schedule
The Falcon 9 is a two-stage rocket used for these missions
The first-stage booster landed on the droneship Of Course I Still Love You
There was a separate, non-SpaceX Minotaur IV launch from Vandenberg on April 7, 2026
